abilities.name: Assess
abilities.desc: Reset your Hits, clear one Guard Break. You gain an important insight for this fight (provided by the GM). Add advantage to your stamina roll.

abilities.name: Regroup
abilities.desc: Up to 4 allies (you can be one of them) gain 1 stamina, clear 2 hits, and are granted a short move to be made immediately.

abilities.name: Show of Force
abilities.desc: Make an attack. Grant an attack for two allies. If your attack missed, their attacks are at disadvantage.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.trigger: An ally is wounded by an attack
abilities.desc: Ally clears half the hits (RD) taken in the attack. Grant any ally (could be the same) a short move and an action to take immediately

abilities.name: Bravado
abilities.desc: Attack with advantage. If it's a solid hit, allies gain 2 Stamina

abilities.name: Clever Zinger
abilities.desc: Invoke a hazard (your choice) for all enemies able to perceive and understand you. Failing takes 1d6 - 1 hits (min 0), but no wounds are possible

abilities.name: Let's Get'em!
abilities.trigger: An enemy attack misses an ally
abilities.desc: Ally gets advantage on next stamina roll. Make an attack, at +1 if against the enemy that missed.

abilities.name: Look Out!
abilities.trigger: An ally is attacked
abilities.desc: Ally's Guard is raised by 2 for the attack.

abilities.name: Bring it On
abilities.desc: Clear 2 hits, and 1 more per enemy you're threatened by or threatening. Make an attack at +1.

abilities.name: Used to This
abilities.desc: Make two melee attacks against different targets. If you like the first roll, spend 1 stamina to apply it to the second target instead of rolling the second.

abilities.name: Counterblow
abilities.trigger: You are hit by a melee attack
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack back at them at -1

abilities.name: Right Behind You
abilities.trigger: An enemy moves out of your threatened area
abilities.desc: After they move, move short to the nearest square adjacent to them. Make an attack against them and invoke Surprise (advantage)

abilities.name: Caltrops
abilities.desc: Pick two pairs of squares sharing one side, with at least one of each pair within a medium move. Anyone occupying them gains Distracted. Any move into or out of those squares: invoke Disruption, take 1 hit on failure

abilities.name: Throw Net
abilities.desc: Make a ranged attack at +1, -4 hits. On a glance or better, invoke Disruption. Target is Grappled on failure.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.desc: Move short directly toward an opponent. Make an attack at +1

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack.

abilities.name: Welcoming Strike
abilities.trigger: An enemy moves into your threatened area.
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack against them

abilities.name: Clobber
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack. On a hit, invoke a Stagger hazard. on failure, +2 hits and you clear 2 hits. Feels good every time.

abilities.name: Reckless Strike
abilities.desc: Make an attack with advantage. You have disadvantage on your next stamina roll.

abilities.name: Wild Strikes
abilities.desc: Make up to 3 melee attacks in succession. If an attack glances, gain 2 hits. If it misses completely, gain 3 hits instead. You can stop at any time.

abilities.name: Unfazed
abilities.trigger: You take a wound from an attack
abilities.desc: Clear 2 hits. Make an attack.

abilities.name: Combat Grab
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack, -3 hits. if it hits, opponent is Grappled

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack, -3 hits. If you glance or better, invoke Disruption and on failure their weapon is wrenched free and falls

abilities.name: Takedown
abilities.desc: Make an attack, -3 hits. On a glance or better, invoke Disruption. On failure, they take d6 hits and are prone.

abilities.name: Redirect
abilities.trigger: Someone moves into or within your threatened space
abilities.desc: Make an attack. Invoke Disruption (stop movement and move the opponent to any unoccupied square adjacent to you). Optionally, you may move into the square they occupied when doing this.

abilities.name: Combat Roll
abilities.desc: Move 1 + half your short move (round up) and make an attack at +1

abilities.name: Grim Determination
abilities.desc: Make an attack. If you are wounded, it is with advantage

abilities.name: Keep the Momentum
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack at -1. Target is Distracted on a glance or better.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.trigger: An attack against you misses
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack, at +1 if against the attacker.

abilities.name: Combined Might
abilities.desc: Make an attack. Grant your companion an attack on the same target, with advantage if your attack glanced or better.

abilities.name: Hear Me Roar
abilities.trigger: Your companion is downed. You can use this reaction on your turn
abilities.desc: Move short, make an attack at +1, with advantage if against anyone who attacked your companion this turn. Move yourself in the turn order to go next. If this is your turn, instead take an extra action. Your companion's next Fate roll is with advantage.

abilities.name: Cross Shot
abilities.desc: Call a target and grant an ally an attack against them. Make a ranged attack. +1 to your attack if their attack hit, and another +1 if you attack the called target.

abilities.name: Point Blank
abilities.desc: Make a ranged attack. Ignore disadvantage from being threatened. If it hits and the target is within short, target is Shaken.

abilities.name: Rapid Shot
abilities.desc: Make a ranged attack. Take another action, however all further actions this turn cost +1 stamina (cumulative). You can take this action twice per turn.

abilities.name: Press the Attack
abilities.trigger: An ally wounds an enemy
abilities.desc: That ally and up to two others make a stamina roll. Make an attack.

abilities.name: Cruel Strike
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack. +1 if the target is wounded.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.desc: Make an attack with advantage. If an ally threatens your target, regain 2 stamina. If the attack results in no wounds taken, regain 1 stamina.    * Cost reduced by 2 if target has not yet taken an action in this encounter

abilities.name: Close One!
abilities.trigger: An enemy attack misses you
abilities.desc: Clear d6 hits.

abilities.name: Deft Strike
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack, +2 hits

abilities.name: Encourage
abilities.desc: An ally clears 1d6+1 hits and gains 1 stamina.  You may take another action. You cannot Encourage the same ally more than once per turn.

abilities.name: Inspiring Presence
abilities.desc: Make an attack. Allies within medium of you or the target clear hits equal to half of the hits caused by the attack.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.trigger: An ally makes an attack
abilities.desc: You each clear 1d6 hits. if within short, ally's attack has +1

abilities.name: Dirty Fighting
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack and invoke Disruption with +1 rank. On failure: Grant an ally an attack on the target with advantage. Before this, you may optionally take your target's position and displace them one square.

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.desc: Invoke Surprise and make an attack against a target.  On failure: the attack is made with advantage.

abilities.name: In Over Your Head
abilities.desc: Make an attack at +1. If the target is wounded after the attack, and the attack glanced or better, invoke Dread. On failure, they are Panicked.

abilities.name: Gang Up
abilities.trigger: An enemy you threaten is hit by an attack
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack with advantage against that enemy.

abilities.name: Emergency Care
abilities.desc: Make a healing check on a downed ally. The difficulty is twice their Fate. On success remove d3 wounds and ally automatically rolls a six on their next Fate roll.

abilities.name: Guided Care
abilities.desc: Guide an adjacent ally to assist your wounds. Remove d3 wounds from yourself.

abilities.name: Protect the Needfuls
abilities.trigger: You are wounded from an attack
abilities.desc: Wounds taken is reduced by 1 (min 0). Take 1d6 hits per wound reduced. That could have been worse.

abilities.name: Fierce Protection
abilities.desc: Move short into ally's square and shift them to any square adjacent to you. Ally gains 1 stamina and clears 2 hits.  Take another action.

abilities.name: Flashing Taunt
abilities.desc: Pick a target. Until the end of your next turn, if they make any attack that doesn't include you as a target, they become Distracted (before their attack is made). Take another Action.

abilities.name: Thick of It
abilities.trigger: Ally adjacent to you is attacked
abilities.desc: Take 1d6 hits and subtract that amount from the attack result. You may swap positions with the ally.

abilities.name: Finisher
abilities.desc: Make an attack. On hit, if there is no wound stabilization roll needed, target must make one anyway. If the result required a wound recovery roll, it is made at disadvantage.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack with +1. You may shift 1 just before the attack, and optionally shift back afterward

abilities.name: Doesn't Look Bad
abilities.trigger: You or an ally is wounded from an attack
abilities.desc: Wounds taken is reduced by 1 (down to 1)

abilities.name: Hit'em Back
abilities.trigger: You are hit by an attack
abilities.desc: Make an attack, +1 if against the target that hit you. Clear 2 hits, and clear 2 more if your attack hit.

abilities.name: Forceful Charge
abilities.desc: Move

abilities.name: Knockdown
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack. Invoke Stagger, +1 rank on solid hits. On failure, target is Prone.

abilities.name: Mighty Strike
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack +1

abilities.name: You Are Weak
abilities.trigger: You are hit by an attack
abilities.desc: Your next attack has +1. Your next stamina roll is made with advantage.

abilities.name: Front Line Terror
abilities.desc: Enemies within short of you gain 2 hits. Pick an enemy you threaten and invoke Dread. On failure, they gain an additional d6 hits. Make an attack against them

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.desc: Make an attack. Up to two allies within short may move short towards you.

abilities.name: The Best Defense
abilities.desc: Reset the hits of yourself and an ally within a short move. If the ally is wounded, grant them an attack

abilities.name: Not So Fast
abilities.trigger: An enemy moves within your threatened area
abilities.desc: Make a melee attack, on a glance or better invoke Stagger, On failure, the target's movement ends and they remain where they started in your threatened area.

abilities.name: Heavy Charge
abilities.desc: On your mount, move long straight toward a target and attack with advantage and +1

abilities.name: Strikes from on High
abilities.desc: Make two melee attacks from your mount.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.desc: Make an attack. If it hits, add 1 wound to the result if the target is prone, otherwise invoke Stagger(target is prone). Your next stamina roll has disadvantage. Take another action. You can only trample twice in one turn.

abilities.name: Swift Mercy
abilities.desc: Make an attack. You have disadvantage on your next stamina roll. If the target is wounded, the attack is made with advantage.

abilities.name: Undivided Attention
abilities.desc: Select a target. Your next 2 attacks against that target are at +1. One attack with this bonus is lost each time you are attacked or attack a different target; all are lost if you use this action again. Take another action.

abilities.name: Fall back
abilities.trigger: An enemy begins to threaten you
abilities.desc: Move short.

abilities.name: Kill Shot
abilities.trigger: An enemy is solidly hit
abilities.desc: Make a ranged attack at +1 against the same target.
